The '''1982–83 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 47th season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. The season began on 19 September 1982 and ended on 26 June 1983. [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] won their fourth consecutive and 24th Greek title.

The point system was: ''Win: 2 points'' - ''Draw: 1 point''.
